behavior: Reconnect listeners wake sync after offline-to-online transitions and network-type changes.
Returning to the foreground checks current connectivity, including recovery missed while backgrounded.
Failed cloud uploads remain pending and retry the latest local snapshot every 15 seconds while active. Healthy idle saves do not upload on this timer.
The wallet retains its existing 10-second fallback and single-flight queue with persisted request identities.
Supabase requests have a 15-second deadline and retain caller cancellation. The transport does not automatically replay requests.
Failed initial cloud uploads stay in initial recovery rather than reporting successful synchronization.
